generators.carrier: finite sector index with nonnegative rational weights, positive total, no amplitudes
w_i / sum_j w_j on finite index

relations.statement: For w_i >= 0 with S = sum w_i > 0, the normalized p_i = w_i/S satisfies p_i >= 0 and sum p_i = 1.
relations.hypotheses: finite index, nonnegative weights, positive total

relations.statement: normalize(c*w) = normalize(w) for every c > 0, so the scale of the representative is discarded.

lemmas.statement: Given nonnegative finite weights with positive total, w_i/S is a probability vector; no square root, complex scalar or inner product is used.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem normalize_law {n : Nat} (w : Fin n → ℚ) (h0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hS : 0 < ∑ i, w i) : (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i / ∑ j, w j) ∧ ∑ i, w i / ∑ j, w j = 1 := by sorry

near_misses.claim: Normalization is defined when all weights are zero.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The total must be positive; a zero total leaves w_i/S undefined.

near_misses.claim: Normalized weights determine amplitudes, including signs and phases.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Absolute values plus normalization discard scale, signs and orientation (qm_003), and this node attaches no amplitudes.

open_obligations: No existing declaration in @SRC covers the generic normalization of nonnegative weights; the ResidualSectorWeights and HilbertLift entries concern other objects, so all refs are proposed_new.
The Lean skeleton is unelaborated and uses sorry.
The qm_020 and qm_003 notes are not in @SRC and are not cited.
